description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractMessageSignalMapper' which serves as a base class for mapping signals related to message commands within the Ditto protocol adapter. It provides methods for validating signals, constructing topic paths, extracting message subjects and status codes, enhancing payloads, and managing headers, all tailored for signals that involve messages associated with things identified by 'ThingId'.

classes.name: AbstractMessageSignalMapper
classes.description: An abstract class that provides common logic for mapping message-related signals within the Ditto protocol, supporting extraction of message subjects, status codes, headers, and payload enhancement.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the given signal is on the LIVE channel; throws IllegalArgumentException if not.

methods.name: getTopicPath
methods.description: Constructs and returns the topic path for the message based on the signal's associated ThingId and subject.

methods.name: extractSubject
methods.description: Abstract method to extract the subject string from the given signal.

methods.name: extractStatusCode
methods.description: Abstract method to extract the HttpStatusCode from the given signal.

methods.name: extractMessageHeaders
methods.description: Abstract method to extract message headers from the given signal.

methods.name: enhancePayloadBuilder
methods.description: Enhances the PayloadBuilder with message content, status, and payload extracted from the signal's JSON representation.

methods.name: enhanceHeaders
methods.description: Merges message headers into the signal's ditto headers, giving message headers precedence.
